artifacts.code_manifest.json: SHA-256 map of every benchmark and Hybrid source file affecting the frozen run.
artifacts.completion_manifest.jsonl: One validation/test row with immutable observed and completion physical-peak indices.
artifacts.core/seed_<seed>/hybrid/checkpoint_resum: Selected or rejected Hybrid checkpoint generations and their frozen context hash.
artifacts.core/seed_<seed>/hybrid/checkpoints/chec: SHA-256 sidecar for one atomic discovery or encoder epoch checkpoint; only the newest configured generations are retained.
External weights-only resumable state containing topics, gamma, optimizers, RNG, counters, and histories but no duplicated spectra or feature cache.
artifacts.core_artifact_reuse.json: Hash inventory and source-protocol provenance when a derived execution-only run reuses completed DreaMS and Tomotopy artifacts.
artifacts.core/complete.json: Proof that every required seed and both topic-model methods completed.
artifacts.core/seed_<seed>/<method>/complete.json: Per-method metrics, initial/final alpha summaries, execution settings, and SHA-256 digests for every consumed beta, theta, and finalized model artifact.
artifacts.environment.json: Python, operating-system, hardware, and dependency provenance at freeze time.
artifacts.execution_log.jsonl: Append-only exact stage commands, executables, Conda environments, timestamps, and status.
artifacts.features/manifest.json: DreaMS cache dimensions, provenance, leakage flags, timing, memory, and output hashes.
artifacts.freeze_summary.json: Source parsing, split, vocabulary, document-completion, and zero-leak audit counts.
artifacts.input_manifest.json: Absolute input locations, byte sizes, and SHA-256 digests.
artifacts.mag/complete.json: Proof of all per-seed MAG arms, filtered-index provenance, raw-DreaMS completion, and legacy environment.
artifacts.mag/seed_<seed>/<method>/topics.jsonl: Per-topic MAG retrieval, clustering, SOS, coverage, and error rows whose SHA-256 is declared by the method result.
artifacts.model_assignments.json: Chemistry-free spectrum-ID to partition map consumed by model workers.
artifacts.protocol.lock.json: Self-hashed lock over configuration, manifests, source, command, branch, commit, dirty state, prior test inspection, and any execution-only parent derivation.
artifacts.report/mag_agreement.jsonl: Same-seed matched MACCS consensus agreement; similarity, not correctness.
artifacts.report/mag_per_seed.jsonl: MAG coverage, SOS, failure, runtime, memory, and exclusion audit for every method and seed.
artifacts.report/manuscript_results.tex: Generated seed-median or explicitly single-seed-indicative table for transcription into the method document.
artifacts.report/per_seed_metrics.csv: One row per required seed and inference arm with predictive, convergence, alpha, diversity, timing, and memory metrics.
artifacts.report/summary.json: Complete per-seed and aggregate report including limitations and raw-DreaMS baseline.
artifacts.report/topic_similarity.jsonl: Optimal topic matches within methods across seeds when available and between methods within seeds.
artifacts.split_manifest.jsonl: One source-spectrum row with partition and chemistry fields for independent leakage auditing.
artifacts.vocabulary.json: Sorted vocabulary constructed from training spectra only.

null_policy: JSON null denotes an unavailable or inapplicable metric; NaN and infinity are forbidden.
result_scope: Generated run artifacts stay outside Git; smoke outputs are software validation only.
